model_cards.name: Hard-time rules engine
model_cards.method: Minimum remaining across applicable FH/EFH/cycles/landings/calendar limits
model_cards.limits: No uncertainty interval (deterministic rule, not a statistical model).

model_cards.name: Survival model (Weibull AFT)
model_cards.purpose: Failure risk for on-condition and condition-monitored components
model_cards.inputs: Unit-level exposure (FH, hot-climate share, ACM share, lot)
model_cards.method: lifelines WeibullAFTFitter per part number, parametric bootstrap for intervals
model_cards.outputs: Conditional failure probability, FH to threshold with interval, covariate time ratios
model_cards.limits: Covariates only fit with enough events; small fleet-wide event counts limit statistical power for some part numbers.

model_cards.name: Engine trend monitor
model_cards.purpose: Engine temperature margin deterioration tracking (EGT margin on the fighter turbofan, ITT margin on the turboprops)
model_cards.inputs: Per-sortie EGT or ITT margin readings for every installed engine position
model_cards.method: Theil-Sen robust slope over trailing 150 EFH since installation, compared with the fleet slopes for the same metric (5th percentile and confidence interval steeper than the fleet median)
model_cards.outputs: Projected EFH to the margin limit (10 °C EGT, 15 °C ITT)
model_cards.limits: Needs at least 100 EFH and 30 readings since installation to produce a stable slope.

model_cards.name: Fatigue projection
model_cards.purpose: Airframe fatigue index (FI) limit forecasting for every type
model_cards.inputs: Sortie mission mix and per-sortie FI consumption (g-loading for the fighter; pressurisation cycles, landings and gust exposure for the transport and airlifter)
model_cards.method: Trailing 12-month consumption rate, linear projection to FI 100
model_cards.outputs: Projected date, life-gain estimate for reducing the type's most fatigue-heavy mission
model_cards.limits: Linear projection; does not model future mission-mix changes beyond the simple what-if shift.

model_cards.name: Pattern detectors
model_cards.purpose: Lot defects, environmental effects, repeat snags, oil precursor
model_cards.inputs: Unit exposure, snag register, maintenance records
model_cards.method: Binomial rate comparison (Bonferroni-corrected), AFT covariate significance, rolling-window snag/NFF counts
model_cards.outputs: Flagged lots, environmental time ratios, repeat-snag list, precursor correlation
model_cards.limits: Statistical power is limited by this fleet's size (16 aircraft); some planted effects are weak at this scale even when real.

validation.note: Temporal backtest: models trained on data up to 15 Nov 2025 and evaluated on 16 Nov 2025 to 15 Nov 2026. Pattern recovery is scored against ground_truth.json after the detectors have run. All figures are computed on synthetic data.

simplifications: Recall counts alerts from the hard-time rules and the survival model only. Pattern-based recommendations (lot, repeat snag, oil precursor, engine trend, fatigue) are not replayed at past as-of points, so recall is a lower bound for the full engine.
Alerts are evaluated at monthly as-of points (the 15th of each month from 15 Nov 2025 to 15 Oct 2026). An alert stays open until the unit is removed.

Model alerts follow the live queue: urgency bands U1 to U3, priority from the section 6 matrix, so a U3 flight-safety item is Medium and a U3 mission item is Low. Hard-time alerts use bands U1 to U3. Only Medium or higher counts.
Tyres and brakes are excluded from every metric, as they are from the live recommendation queue (routine wear consumables, not failures to predict).
Units installed during the test window start at zero FH with covariates taken from their aircraft's flying over the 365 days before installation.

Exposure uses the production definition (gold unit_exposure.csv): hours flown inside the data window in the part's life basis (APU hours for APUs, FH otherwise) plus the time since new carried on the history card for units already fitted when the window opens. As in production, the survival fit conditions those units on their age at the window start (delayed entry).
